properties.displayName: Registry Event ASIM parser for CrowdStrike Falcon Data Replicator
properties.query:
let parser = (
      disabled: bool=false
      , pack: bool=false
)
{
    let EventTypeLookup = datatable(RegOperationType: string, EventType: string)
        [
            "1", "RegistryValueSet"
            , "2", "RegistryValueDeleted"
            , "3", "RegistryKeyCreated"
            , "4", "RegistryKeyDeleted"
            , "5", "RegistryValueSet"
            , "6", "RegistryKeyCreated"
            , "7", "RegistryKeyRenamed"
            // , "8", "Other"
            // , "9", "Other"
            , "101", "RegistryValueSet"
            , "102", "RegistryValueDeleted"
        ]
    ;
    let RegistryValueTypeLookup = datatable(RegType: string, RegistryValueType: string)
        [
            "0", "Reg_None"
            , "1", "Reg_Sz"
            , "2", "Reg_Expand_Sz"
            , "3", "Reg_Binary"
            , "4", "Reg_Dword"
            , "5", "Reg_Dword_Big_Endian"
            , "6", "Reg_Link"
            , "7", "Reg_Multi_Sz"
            , "8", "Reg_Resource_List"
            , "9", "Reg_Full_Resource_Descriptor"
            , "10", "Reg_Resource_Requirements_List"
            , "11", "Reg_Qword"
        ]
    ;
    CrowdStrike_Registry_Events_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | extend
        EventStartTime = unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(ContextTimeStamp * 1000)
        , EventEndTime = unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(timestamp)
        , RegistryKey = replace_string(
            replace_string(
                RegObjectName
                , @'\REGISTRY\MACHINE'
                , 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE'
            )
            , @'\REGISTRY\USER'
            , 'HKEY_USERS'
        )
        , RegistryValueData = case(
            isnotempty(RegStringValue), RegStringValue
            , isnotempty(RegNumericValue), tostring(RegNumericValue)
            , isnotempty(RegBinaryValue), RegBinaryValue
            , ""
        )
    | lookup EventTypeLookup on RegOperationType
    | project-rename 
        DvcIpAddr = aip
        , DvcId = aid
        , EventOriginalType = name
        , EventOriginalUid = CrowdStrikeId
        , EventUid = _ItemId
        , EventProductVersion = ConfigBuild
        , ActingProcessId = ContextThreadId
        , ParentProcessId = ContextProcessId
        , RegistryValue = RegValueName
        , ActorUsername = UserName
        , EventSubType = event_simpleName
        , EventOriginalSubType = RegOperationType
    | lookup RegistryValueTypeLookup on RegType
    | extend
        DvcIdType = "Other"
        , DvcOs = case(
            event_platform == "Win", "Windows"
            , event_platform == "Mac", "Macintosh"
            , event_platform == "Lin", "Linux"
            , ""
        )
        , RegistryPreviousKey = iff(EventType == "RegistryKeyRenamed", RegistryKey, "")
        , ActorUsernameType = iff(isnotempty(ActorUsername), "Simple", "")
        , AdditionalFields = iff (
            pack
            , bag_pack(
                "cid", cid
                , "ConfigStateHash", ConfigStateHash
                , "TreeId", TreeId
                , "OciContainerId", OciContainerId
                , "TokenType", TokenType
                , "AuthenticationId", AuthenticationId
                , "RegClassificationFlags", RegClassificationFlags
                , "RegClassificationIndex", RegClassificationIndex
                , "Entitlements", Entitlements
                , "EffectiveTransmissionClass", EffectiveTransmissionClass
                , "BoundingLimitCount", BoundingLimitCount
                , "BoundingLimitDuration", BoundingLimitDuration
            )
        , dynamic({})
        )
    //Mandatory fields and Alias's
    | extend
        EventCount = int(1)
        , EventSchemaVersion = "0.1.3"
        , EventSchema = "RegistryEvent"
        , EventVendor = "CrowdStrike"
        , EventProduct = "Falcon Data Replicator"
        , EventResult = "Success"
        , EventSeverity = "Informational"
        , Dvc = DvcId
        , User = iff(isnotempty(ActorUsername), ActorUsername, "")
    | project
        TimeGenerated
        , Type
        , EventStartTime
        , EventEndTime
        , EventType
        , EventResult
        , EventSeverity
        , EventCount
        , EventSchema
        , EventSchemaVersion
        , EventVendor
        , EventProduct
        , EventOriginalType
        , EventOriginalUid
        , EventUid
        , EventProductVersion
        , DvcIpAddr
        , DvcId
        , DvcIdType
        , DvcOs
        , RegistryKey
        , RegistryValue
        , RegistryValueData
        , RegistryValueType
        , RegistryPreviousKey
        , ParentProcessId
        , ActingProcessId
        , ActorUsername
        , ActorUsernameType
        , AdditionalFields
        , Dvc
        , User
        , EventSubType
        , EventOriginalSubType
  };
parser(
  disabled = disabled
  , pack = pack
)
